coordinate_contract: 2D metres in an origin-anchored local frame; same transform for predictions and truth
truth_contract: original observed positions only; scoring-time eligibility/selection must be sealed separately; no interpolation by the scorer

primary.name: time_weighted_energy_score_m
primary.time_weights: explicit nonnegative vector summing to one, frozen before final eval

secondary.name: ade_grid_mean_m
secondary.estimator: unweighted mean over registered scoring instants of distance from ensemble mean to truth

secondary.name: fde_m
secondary.estimator: final scoring instant error of ensemble mean; never minimum particle error

secondary.name: radial_coverage
secondary.estimator: inclusion in ensemble-mean-centred disk with ceil(level*N) order-statistic radius
secondary.limitation: not HDR and not joint trajectory coverage

secondary.name: radial_area
secondary.estimator: pi * radius^2, paired with observed coverage

secondary.name: particle_endpoint_error_quantiles_m
secondary.limitation: within one forecast ensemble, distinct from population quantiles of per-origin FDE

secondary.name: path_energy_score_m
secondary.estimator: joint path ES after multiplying each 2D position by sqrt(time_weight); supplementary dependence-sensitive score

secondary.name: position_entropy
secondary.estimator: plug-in categorical entropy on frozen 2D position bins plus one overflow bin
secondary.limitation: not differential entropy, not accuracy, not joint-path entropy

secondary.name: nll
secondary.reason: no qualified predictive density estimator; no Gaussian shortcut

secondary.name: mode_entropy
secondary.reason: current kinematic model is not mode-labelled

secondary.name: joint_path_entropy
secondary.reason: marginal entropy sum is not joint entropy

aggregation_contract: one origin/seed report; independent-block and seed aggregation belongs to the sealed paired-inference protocol

runtime.cold: provider recreated; OS cache and interpreter not cold
runtime.gpu: unsupported by CPU timing harness; CPU runs report GPU memory as not applicable

failure_contract: nonfinite forecasts/targets reject scoring; caller must retain failed origin/seed in denominator. Never drop failures to improve scores
prohibited: No combined arbitrary accuracy-runtime score and no best-of-N accuracy
